concepts.prompt: Game asset concept: a tall hanging cloth tapestry banner (1.2 m wide by 3.2 m tall) hung from a turned warm oak wooden rod with round finials and a cord. Heavy woven cream fabric with a deep tether-blue (#4aa8e0 and darker blue) field and border, and in the centre the emblem from the reference: a cream arched doorway with seven small octagonal dots in an arc above it. Bottom edge cut into a swallowtail with small tassels. Soft cloth folds, slightly thick stylised cloth. Stylised Palworld-like game prop, chunky readable shapes, soft bevelled edges, hand-painted PBR look, warm natural palette matching the Meadows key art (first reference). Single isolated object, centred, neutral grey background, even studio lighting, no text, no characters, no ground clutter.
reference_paths: assets/ui/hall_waymark.svg (rasterised with PIL, cream on blue)

agent_visual_verdict: Good: blue field, cream border, waymark arch emblem, swallowtail with tassels, oak rod; back is plain cream.
notes: Used views 0 (front) and 1 (back) only; view 2 was inconsistent.
